fig1_architecture: Figure 1. System architecture. The embedding backbone is trained once off-line and deployed as an ONNX graph (built into an FP16 or INT8 TensorRT engine on the target); inference, open-set rejection, field enrollment and governance logging all run on the edge node with no network connection. Enrollment writes prototypes to the store; no model weights change after deployment.
fig2_enrollment: Figure 2. Field enrollment without retraining. (a) Macro-F1 on newly enrolled species versus number of enrollment shots k; (b) change in macro-F1 on the species already in the store after enrollment (DR5). Points are means over n = 30 episodes; error bars are ± 1 SE. The legend applies to both panels.
fig3_openset: Figure 3. Open-set rejection of unenrolled species (DR6). (a) ROC of the nearest-prototype distance as an unknown-ness score for one representative episode, with the operating point at the calibrated 95th-percentile threshold; (b) distance distributions behind it. Across n = 60 episodes the mean AUROC was 0.922 ± 0.003 (SE).
fig4_transfer: Figure 4. Aerial enrollment with a ground-trained backbone (DR7). Species seen only from the air (CoFly-WeedDB) enrolled from k UAV image crops per species and evaluated on held-out crops. Means over n = 30 episodes; error bars ± 1 SE.
fig5_cost: Figure 5. Season-level cost of three deployment options for a fleet of 10 nodes (DR8). (a) Cost breakdown at the base case of 200 000 frames per node and 2 newly encountered species per season; (b) total cost as the inference workload varies; (c) total cost as the number of new species varies, the driver of retraining cost. Dotted vertical lines mark the base case. Assumptions in Table 4.
fig6_sensitivity: Figure 6. One-at-a-time sensitivity of the season saving of option A (offline edge with field enrollment) to ± 50 % changes in each cost assumption, (a) relative to cloud inference (base saving USD 3180) and (b) relative to a closed-world edge model with periodic retraining (base saving USD 1379). Parameters shared by both options cancel and are omitted.
